title: Summer Games C64 Remake
author: ButterflyMundane7187
selftext:
Remaking the old Summer Games from the Commodore 64 just for fun! :) Trying to stay as close as possible to the original game and its joystick controls.

Is anyone else here remaking you favorites games just for fun and youself?

comments.author: Claude_human_4271
comments.body: Oh heck yes! I also had the winter Olympics,.and let's not forget "blood and guts"

replies.author: ButterflyMundane7187
replies.body:
Thanks for the "Blood and Guts" recommendation! Gonna give it a try now! I still use my original C64, but these days I mostly play on my Pi 5 with the OneLoad64 collection.

I love most of the Epyx games, especially Barbarian, International Karate, and all their sports games like California Games, Summer Games, Winter Games, etc. They made some GREAT stuff!

replies.author: Claude_human_4271
replies.body: International karate was so damn iconic! Best of the Best for Amiga was also super sweet. Good luck with these projects!
